title: THE BULLY'S SECRET IS FINALLY OUT! 🛴

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Bruno, I know you stole my midnight scooter [beat] but instead of calling the police, I'm handing you these keys to my brand new locker!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You think giving me your locker makes us even [beat] after I spent weeks making your life a living nightmare in these dusty hallways?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s not just a locker, Bruno; it’s the only place in this school [beat] where the security cameras have a massive blind spot for your secret stash.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait, how did you find out about the vintage parts I've been hoarding [beat] to fix my grandmother’s old oxygen machine in the basement?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I saw you crying behind the gym last Tuesday [beat] and realized you weren't a monster, just a kid trying to save his family with zero options.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: So you didn't report the scooter theft [beat] even though you had the HD footage of me breaking the lock and riding it away into the dark?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Reporting you would have ruined your life forever [beat] but helping you fix that machine means you actually owe me a massive favor now, tough guy.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Nix, I heard there was a disturbance here [beat] regarding a stolen scooter, so why is Bruno standing there looking like he’s seen a ghost?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Actually, Principal Huda, Bruno was just returning my scooter [beat] after he spent the entire night professionally tuning the engine for me as a surprise.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That is remarkably generous of you, Bruno [beat] and since you’re being such a model citizen, I’ll cancel that detention you had scheduled for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I can’t believe you just lied to the Principal for me [beat] after I treated you like total garbage since the first day of freshman year.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Consider the debt paid in full, Bruno [beat] but if I ever see you picking on another kid, those camera files are going straight to the cops.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
